_doc: Pre-registered review windows, kill rules, and triggers for the bot fleet.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: two pre-registrations rotted silently in May 2026 —
the FF ARB 3rd-loss trigger (fired 2026-05-14, evaluated 26 days late) and
because they lived only in commit messages and session memory.
Every entry with status 'open' is surfaced in the daily health report
marker once review_by passes. Closing an entry requires a human decision
recorded in 'resolution'. New pre-registrations MUST be added here, not

rules: Rollback gate v2 if account MaxDD > 3.60% (1.5x backtest 2.40%)
Kill/demote if PF < 0.7 over 30+ closed trades since 2026-05-19
If <10 closed trades by review_by, the PF rule is NOT evaluable: review must instead compare gate-open time vs backtest expectation and decide extend/simplify, not auto-pass
preregistrations.notes: Original window said '90d or 75 trades, whichever first' — at the gate-v2 backtest rate (1.67 trades/wk) 75 trades takes ~10 months, so the trade arm was vacuous. Live rate since redeploy is ZERO trades in 21d (BTC below SMA50/200 — mostly the pre-existing v1 base gate). Audited 2026-06-09.

rules: At >=20 closed trades: continue dry-run if PF >= 1.0 AND WR >= 60% (deployed-docstring backtest: PF 1.62, WR 77.8%); else kill
If <10 closed trades by review_by: frequency anomaly (P ~3.9% under backtest cadence 4.37 trades/month over the 113-day window) — investigate signal-rate mismatch before extending
preregistrations.notes: Replaces the expired v1 gate ('>=5 trades in 30d', ended 2026-06-08 with 2 trades). v1 gate was mis-specified: only ~44% pass probability even if the backtest were perfect. Plumbing verified 2026-06-09: exactly 2 qualifying cascade candles occurred market-wide since deploy (both ZEC 2026-06-05) and the bot captured 2/2 with correct next-bar entries. See docs/cascade_gate_evaluation_2026-06-09.md.

preregistrations.resolution: Trigger (3rd ARB stop-loss) fired 2026-05-14, evaluated 2026-06-09 (26 days late — the {duration} webhook bug had blinded the purpose-built pair-drift detector; fixed in 17acebc). Evaluation: qualifier 'while other pairs continue winning' NOT met — the 3rd ARB SL fell inside the fleet-wide 5-SL streak (TAO/BCH/SUI also stopped), so the loss is regime-wide, not ARB-idiosyncratic. No pair blacklist, per feedback_pairlist_strategy (never blacklist coins reactively). The original 'informed shorts' diagnosis was also a misread: post-extreme funding normalizing to Binance's +0.01% baseline clamp is the mechanical modal outcome, not evidence of informed flow. ARB stays in the whitelist; macro gate v2 is the regime defense.

rules: Trade-level calibration on deployed-actual configs BEFORE any fidelity fix (baseline capture)
OOS window = 2026-05-19 onward (data cutoff proven; zero selection influence)
No kill/scale decision on OOS PF alone at N<10 trades; calibration is primary metric
FF runs use modeled funding AVAILABILITY (4h-drift diagnostic + hourly-fix intended), never omniscient history
Keltner and Cascade each tested in BOTH validated-intended and deployed-actual variants
Report must include leave-one-pair-out (FF ex-ZEC), correlated-loss clustering, rolling-window stability
Zero-deployable-edge is a pre-registered acceptable outcome
followups: cascade-fill-model-stress-test before trusting any Cascade backtest number
F2 FF freshness guard: shadow-log then deploy at next natural FF restart
2026-08-17 review: FF gate-open-time fallback binds (1 signal / 310 gate-open hours vs 1.67/wk claimed)

preregistrations.hypothesis: Persistently positive HL hourly funding is capturable delta-neutral: short HL perp + spot hedge (T1 Binance spot / T2 HL spot), at realistic mixed fees

config_declared.entry: trailing-24h HL funding annualized >= 40%/yr (settled data only, effective next settlement)
config_declared.no_sweep: single hand-picked config; accepted risk documented

pass_criteria_all_required: median episode net > 0 at realistic-default fees
positive net in BOTH sample halves
net yield >= 12%/yr on REQUIRED CAPITAL (collateral both legs + 50% liq buffer)
>= 10 closed episodes, else inconclusive unless clearly negative after costs
preregistrations.kill_scope: failure kills THIS declared carry implementation, not the structural lane (codex amendment)
preregistrations.universe_framing: current deployable universe replay (top ~20 HL perps with Binance spot twins); survivorship acknowledged; NOT a clean historical edge claim
preregistrations.notes: Binance futures CVM-blocked for operator -> perp-perp topology rejected at design. 1b rider study (HL hourly-funding extreme fade, one fixed config) is EXPLORATORY: can only produce a dry-run candidate. Basis drift from candles = approximate; book-data shadow phase required before any dry-run.

preregistrations.trigger: dry entry chased +4.8% in 10min vs assumed next-bar-open fill (C4 anomaly, oos_retest_2026-07)
preregistrations.design: 1m path-aware replay of lab config (TP3%/SL-8%/48h timeout, 13 pairs, 2023-01->2026-07): uniform entry-slippage ladder {0.25,0.5,1,2,4}% AND adversarial variant (fill at next-1m HIGH; skip trade if next-1m high > signal close +5% = unfilled-cancel model). Fee 0.075%/side. Reconciliation run at 0% slippage must approximate lab metrics (PF~1.6) or the replayer is broken.
preregistrations.verdict_rule: PF < 1.2 at 0.5% uniform slippage OR at adversarial variant -> Cascade backtest case declared UNRELIABLE; recommend demote at next review
preregistrations.notes: Diagnostic/kill study; codex-approved as properly adversarial.
preregistrations.resolution: VERDICT: BACKTEST CASE UNRELIABLE (frozen rule met). PF 1.423 base -> 1.168 @0.25% slip -> 0.984 @0.5% -> 0.931 adversarial (10-min chase model). Monotone steep degradation; even 25bps entry slippage erases most of the edge. Replayer validated (regime shape matches lab; hand-trace verified; N gap vs lab attributed to data vintage + max-3 cap dropping ~47% of clustered signals). RECOMMENDATION: demote/retire CascadeFaderV1 dry bot at next review — its validated backtest case does not survive realistic entry fills.
